project_guidance.title: Welsh roof enlargement checks
project_guidance.intro: Use this starting point with the full official guidance and the planning history for your address.
rules: Roof enlargement has its own Welsh limits; assess the added volume and roof position together.
The guidance specifies less than 40 cubic metres for terraced houses and less than 50 for other houses.
Check principal roof slope, ridge height, eaves setback, materials and window privacy.
Roof extensions on designated land need planning permission.
